evidence_items.locator: Section 4, human preference evaluation; sections 2 and 5 provide disclosure and limitations context
evidence_items.explanation: The report describes human preference for GPT-4 over GPT-3.5 on 70.2% of 5,214 prompts, supporting the capability-improvement component. It also acknowledges reasoning errors and hallucinations while withholding detailed architecture, so it does not settle the architectural diagnosis.

unresolved_gaps: The reviewed evidence does not establish which remaining limitations arise from architecture rather than training, prompting, or other factors.
Reading problematic architecture merely as continuing errors would make the claim easier to support, but would remove a substantive element of its wording.
